column1: # Vanilla places the client names that this addon has nothing for.
# From AreaTable (product wowf, build 1.60.1.70862, read 2026-11-09 via
# wago.tools) matched against every name the addon answers to, aliases
# included. These are CHILD areas: subzones, which GetSubZoneText returns.
# tools/area-sweep.md covers the top-level ones and says what was excluded.
# Excluded from this list and counted in area-sweep.md: dungeon and instance
# interiors, battleground internals, open water, post-vanilla maps such as
# Gilneas, and the Wrath death-knight content sitting inside Eastern
# Plaguelands. What is left is the vanilla overworld on both continents.
# Some of these will be spelling variants of entries that already exist --
# "The Cemetary" against Raven Hill Cemetery, say -- so treat the count as an
# upper bound until each is checked. /ftn areas in game uses the real resolver
